title: Aspen Search statement and figures
description: A mono section label, a long plain statement in a large tight grotesk, and three figures as flat offset tiles on a hairline grid: a small ink tile, a large mint tile and a grey tile hanging at the right (stacked full width on phones). The statement rises in line by line; each figure's digits spin up like an odometer as they scroll into view.
notes: CSS only: line reveals and odometer reels are view timelines, scrubbed with the scroll, off under reduced motion
tile heights are set in vw on desktop, so the offset grid keeps its proportions at any width
